name: Boolean union: box 80 × 60 × 40 mm fused with a protruding boss cylinder r15 × 60 mm
notes: First body-consuming document: the boolean references the box (target) and cylinder (tool) OPERATION ids, consumes both bodies, and only the boolean's output body appears in the evaluation. Geometry: box spans x[-40,40] y[-30,30] z[0,40]; cylinder axis at x=y=0 spans z[20,80], so it is buried in the box for z[20,40] and protrudes for z[40,80] — the cylinder base (z=20) is strictly interior, deliberately avoiding coplanar-face booleans. Analytic derivation: volume = boxV + protruding cylinder = 80*60*40 + pi*15^2*40 = 192000 + 9000*pi; surface = box surface - top-face hole + exposed lateral + top cap = 20800 - 225*pi + 1200*pi + 225*pi = 20800 + 1200*pi; center of mass z = (192000*20 + 9000*pi*60) / (192000 + 9000*pi), x = y = 0. Topology verified against pinned OCCT V8_0_0_p1: 8 faces (6 box faces, the top one carrying the circular hole loop, + boss lateral with seam + boss top cap), 15 edges (12 box + hole circle + seam line + top circle), 10 vertices (8 box + 2 seam endpoints).
